hook:
The numbers.

BMW answered 717 horsepower with an electric motor inside the gearbox.
body:
A twin-turbo V8 married to an electric motor inside the gearbox. It will also do twenty-five miles on battery alone, silently, past your neighbours.

2025 BMW M5 G90 — 717 hp combined · 738 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 3.4 sec.

· 717 hp combined and 738 lb-ft — a figure that needs both the V8 and the motor to reach it.
· 3.4 seconds to 60 mph, and 190 mph with the M Driver’s Package.
· 25 miles of electric range: the school run and the commute, without the V8 waking up.
· M xDrive sends it to all four wheels, and still lets you take the front axle out of the equation.

The hybrid system serves two roles: silent short-range running, and filling torque below the turbos.
cta: Is a 717 hp plug-in hybrid still an M5 to you?
